content:
Rumors have long suggested that Apple has been working on a major revamp of its Home lineup, and a new leak has revealed several upcoming products worth getting excited about.

macOS code leak mentions several unreleased Home devices

Apple's biggest annual event is just weeks away. In addition to the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra, along with the next generation of Apple Watch models, several new Home products are also expected to make an appearance.

Reports indicate that a brand-new Apple TV 4K, the HomePod mini 2, and the long-awaited HomePad are all coming soon, but there are also several other Home products that may debut in the near term.

MacRumors discovered yesterday that the newly released macOS 26.7 RC mentions several yet-to-be-announced products.

Among them are codenames related to Home devices, citing Juli Clover's report:

  • HomePad (J490 and J491): "J490 is believed to be a tabletop home hub version, while J491 is designed for wall-mounted installation."
  • HomePod mini 2 (B525): The HomePod mini's codename is B520, so this is very likely the mini 2.
  • Home Accessory (J229): This should be the rumored security camera product.
  • HomeAccessory17,2 and HomeAccessory17,3: Newly appearing codenames for unknown Home devices.
  • ATVRemote1,5: A next-generation Siri Remote, expected to launch alongside the new Apple TV 4K.

Other Home products reportedly in development also include a video doorbell and a desktop robotic home hub. Whether their codenames appear in the macOS 26.7 leak is not yet clear.

In addition to products, MacRumors also found a term called "Pebble" that is believed to be a codename for homeOS. There is also a string "audio_accessory_visual_reasoning" which may be related to HomePad.

Finally, the data also revealed four colours for an unconfirmed Home accessory: Rose Pink, Silver, Space Gray, and Starlight.
